messages.businessImpact: Nothing checks whether devices meet a security standard, so nothing can be enforced. Every other control here is advisory until compliance exists.
remediation: Create a Windows compliance policy covering encryption, secure boot and a minimum operating system version.
Assign it to all Windows devices and pair it with a Conditional Access policy requiring a compliant device.
messages.cannotSee: Compliance authored in the Settings Catalog is not read: this tool reads the typed compliance API, so a tenant that has moved its Windows compliance there is told it has none. Check the console before acting on this finding.
